class SliderExt(SubWidgetExt):
	"""
	ValueExt is an extension that controls multiple values for a value component.
	A value component is a widget sub component that visualizes and provides
	interactivity for setting values.
	"""
	def __init__(self, ownerComp, dimension=1):
		# The component to which this extension is attached
		"""
		This extension inpterprets panel interactions and controls the
		masterSlider widget values.
		"""
		self.parPrefix = 'Slider'
		SubWidgetExt.__init__(self, ownerComp)
		self.widgetComp = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget
		#Dimesion refers to the dimension of this sub-component.  A slider
		#found in an RGBA widget will have a dimension of 1, while a range
		#slider will have a dimension of 2 since it requires two values
		#for the single ui element
		self.dimension = dimension
		#The value group index allows for multiple range faders in the same
		#widget
		self.valueGroupIndex = 0 #math.floor(self.ownerComp.digits/self.dimension)
		#Slider variables
		self.LoadSliderAttribs(self.valueGroupIndex)

		self.select = False
		self.insideKnob = False
		self.lastClickPos = None
		#The current normalized values

		self.knobIndex = None
		#The function to use to process incoming ValueChange events
		self.valueProc = None
		#The current start values
		self.startValues = []
		self.curValues = []
		self.startDiffs = []

	def LoadSliderAttribs(self, groupIndex):
		"""
		Preloads the slider values for the Value component.
		"""
		#debug('inside', groupIndex)
		self.index = groupIndex
		self.res = [getattr(self.ownerComp, i) for i in ['width', 'height']]
		self.knobWidth = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.par.Sliderknobsize.eval()
		self.orient = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.par.Sliderorient.menuIndex
		#Needs to avoid division by zero error
		self.normKnobWidth = (self.knobWidth / self.res[self.orient]) if self.res[self.orient] > 0 else 0
		self.knobMargin = self.normKnobWidth/2
		self.panelVar = self.ownerComp.panel.v if self.orient \
													else self.ownerComp.panel.u
		self.normSliderMin = self.normKnobWidth/2
		self.normSliderMax = 1-(self.normKnobWidth/2)
		self.Pars = [getattr(self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.par, \
								'Value'+str(i)) for i in range(self.dimension)]
		self.Values = [Value(self.widgetComp, par[1],
								self.valueGroupIndex+par[0]) \
								for par in enumerate(self.Pars)]
		self.relativeMode = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.par.Sliderrelativemode.eval()


	def ValueChange(self, panelValue):
		"""
		Handles a value change taking into consideration all the attributes
		of this slider sub-component.
		"""
		#debug('val chan')
		if self.select:
			#debug('vc')
			if not parent.Widget.par.Sliderviewonly.eval():
				self.valueProc(panelValue.val, self.knobIndex)


	def SelectOn(self):
		"""
		Gathers information when the panel is initially selected. The
		information is used when interaction with the widget sub-component
		panel generates valueChange callback events. These events are
		subsequently handled by the ValueChange() method of this class.
		"""
		#knobClickIndex will be None if not clicked or knob index if a knob
		#was clicked
		knobIndex = self.checkKnobClick()
		#debug('knob', knobIndex)
		if knobIndex is None:
			self.valueProc = self.valueChangeSlider
		else:
			self.valueProc = self.valueChangeKnob
		self.select = True

	def SelectOff(self):
		"""
		Turns off select state for this value.
		"""
		self.select = False
		self.mode = None
		self.valueProc = None
		self.insideKnob = False
		self.lastClickPos = None

	def reNormalizeWithKnobs(self, knobMargin):
		"""
		This function allows for renormalizing the normalized values
		taking into consideration the knob size.
		"""
		return [remap(val, 0, 1, knobMargin, 1-(knobMargin)) \
											for val in self.getNormValues()]
		#return [remap(val, 0, 1, 0, 1) for val in self.getNormValues()]

	def checkKnobClick(self):
		"""
		Checks if click was inside a knob or not.  Returns None if not or the
		knob index starting at 0 if a knob was clicked.
		"""
		#knobMargin = self.normKnobWidth/2
		normValues = self.reNormalizeWithKnobs(self.knobMargin)
		pval = self.panelVar.val
		knobIndex = None
		for i in range(self.dimension):
			#print('check', pval, normValues[i]-(self.knobMargin), normValues[i]+(self.knobMargin), self.knobMargin, self.knobWidth)
			if pval > normValues[i]-(self.knobMargin) and \
										pval < (normValues[i]+(self.knobMargin))\
										or self.relativeMode:
				#print('knobClick')
				self.startValues = self.getNormValues()
				#debug('startValues set', self.startValues)
				self.lastClickPos = pval
				self.insideKnob = True
				knobIndex = i
				self.knobIndex = knobIndex
				break
			else:
				self.startValues = self.getNormValues()
				#debug('startValues set', self.startValues)
				self.lastClickPos = pval
				self.insideKnob = False
				self.knobClickOffset = None
				self.startDiffs = sorted([(i[0], abs(pval - i[1])) for i \
							in enumerate(normValues)], key=lambda tup: tup[1])

		return knobIndex

	def setValue(self, value, index):
		#self.widgetComp.SetValueNorm(value,	index)
		#protoEdit
		#debug('setValue')
		if not parent.Widget.par.Sliderviewonly.eval():
			getattr(parent.Widget.par, 'Value'+ str(parent().digits)).normVal = value

	def getNormValues(self):
		return [self.Values[v].normValue for v in range(self.dimension)]

	def getNormMin(self, index):
		return self.Values[index].normMin

	def getNormMax(self, index):
		return self.Values[index].normMax

	def valueChangeKnob(self, pVal, valueIndex):
		"""
		Changes value using the knob.  This generates a value change only if
		the knob is moved.  Clicking anywhere on the knob will not change
		the value.
		"""
		valueIndex = valueIndex+self.valueGroupIndex
		#debug(valueIndex, 'startvs', self.startValues)
		offset = (pVal-self.lastClickPos)*(1/(1-(self.normKnobWidth)))
		value = (offset + self.startValues[0])
		#value = max(0, min(value, 1))
		#debug('knob', value)
		value = self.Values[valueIndex].valueClampFunc(value)
		self.setValue(value, valueIndex)

	def valueChangeSlider(self, pVal, valueIndex):
		"""
		Changes value not using the knob.  This generates a value change only
		if the slider area with no knob is selected.
		"""
		#print(pVal)
		if valueIndex is not None:
			valueIndex = valueIndex+self.valueGroupIndex
		else:
			valueIndex = self.valueGroupIndex
		value = remap(pVal, self.normSliderMin, self.normSliderMax, 0, 1)
		#value = max(0, min(value, 1))
		value = self.Values[valueIndex].valueClampFunc(value)
		#debug('slider', value)

		##TextCOMP refactor 11/9/2021 - Jarrett
		##value = round(value, parent.Widget.par.Sliderdecimalplaces.eval())

		self.setValue(value, valueIndex)

	def onPanelEvent(self, event, panelValue):
		"""
		"""
		if event == 'offToOn' and panelValue.name == 'select':
			parent.Value.SelectOn()
		elif event == 'onToOff' and panelValue.name == 'select':
			parent.Value.SelectOff()
		elif panelValue.name in ['u', 'v']:
			parent.Value.ValueChange(panelValue)

class Value:
	"""
	Holds value parameter for widgets and provides common features for
	getting and setting values.
	"""
	def __init__(self, widgetComp, valuePar, index):
		self.widgetComp = widgetComp
		self.valuePar = valuePar
		self.valueIndex = index
		self.currentValue = None
		self.lastValue = None
		#self.knobClampMinMax = [widgetComp.par.Sliderclampmin.eval(),
		#				widgetComp.par.Sliderclampmax.eval()]
		self.knobClampMinMax = [getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Value'+str(self.valueIndex)).clampMin,
						getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Value'+str(self.valueIndex)).clampMax]
		#self.normMin = getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Normminmax' + str(index) + '1').eval()
		self.normMin = getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Value'+ str(index)).normMin
		#self.normMax = getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Normminmax' + str(index) + '2').eval()
		self.normMax = getattr(widgetComp.par, 'Value'+ str(index)).normMax
		if self.knobClampMinMax[0] and self.knobClampMinMax[1]:
			self.valueClampFunc = self.clampMinMax
		elif self.knobClampMinMax[0] and not self.knobClampMinMax[1]:
			self.valueClampFunc = self.clampMin
		elif not self.knobClampMinMax[0] and self.knobClampMinMax[1]:
			self.valueClampFunc = self.clampMax
		else:
			self.valueClampFunc = self.clampOff
		self.valueUpdate()

	def valueUpdate(self):
		#debug('valueUpdate')
		self.lastValue = self.currentValue
		self.currentValue = self.valuePar.eval()

	def clampMax(self, value):
		return  min(value, 1)

	def clampMin(self, value):
		return  max(0, value)

	def clampMinMax(self, value):
		return  max(0, min(value, 1))

	def clampOff(self, value):
		return value

	@property
	def normValue(self):
		#return self.widgetComp.GetValueNorm(self.valueIndex)
		#protoEdit
		return getattr(parent.Widget.par, 'Value'+ str(self.valueIndex)).evalNorm()

def remap(val, fromMin, fromMax, toMin, toMax):
	"""
	Remaps val to a new range.
	"""

	result = ( (val - fromMin) / (fromMax - fromMin) ) * (toMax - toMin) + toMin

	return result

TDF = op.TDModules.mod.TDFunctions

class SubWidgetExt:
	"""
	SubWidgetExt description
	"""

	def __init__(self, ownerComp, indexComp=None):
		# The component to which this extension is attached
		self.ownerComp = ownerComp
		if indexComp:
			self.indexComp = indexComp
		else:
			self.indexComp = self.ownerComp

	def onPanelEvent(self, event, panelValue):
		"""
		Panel exec events from widget
		"""
		pass

	def onParSettingsChange(self, par, prev):
		"""
		Manages value changes widget settings parameters
		"""
		val = par.eval()
		if par.name == self.parPrefix + 'runcommand':
			enable = par.eval()
			for suffix in ['commandon', 'commandoff', 'commandonvaluechange']:
				p = self.prefixPar(suffix)
				if p is not None:
					p.enable = enable
		elif par.name == self.parPrefix + 'horizontalmode':
			fill = True if val == 'fill' else False
			self.prefixPar('hfillweight').enable = fill
			self.prefixPar('width').enable = not fill
		elif par.name == self.parPrefix + 'verticalmode':
			fill = True if val == 'fill' else False
			self.prefixPar('vfillweight').enable = fill
			self.prefixPar('height').enable = not fill
		elif par.name in [self.parPrefix + 'bordera',
						  self.parPrefix + 'borderb',
						  self.parPrefix + 'border']:
			getattr(parent.Widget.par, par.name + 'colorr').enable = par.eval()

	def onParSettingsPulse(self, par):
		"""
		Manages pulse events for widget settings parameters
		"""
		if par.name == self.parPrefix + 'customizeinteraction':
			self.makePanelExecute()

	def onToggleEvent(self, event, panelValue):
		if event == 'offToOn':
			self.toggle()

	def toggle(self):
		index = self.indexComp.digits
		valuePar = getattr(parent.Widget.par, 'Value' + str(index))
		valuePar.val = 1 - valuePar.eval()

	def prefixPar(self, suffix):
		"""
		Return a parameter prefixed by parPrefix
		:param suffix: the par name after parPrefix (string)
		:return: the parameter or None if not found
		"""
		return getattr(self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.par,
					   self.parPrefix + suffix, None)

	def getDockExpressionToOwner(self):
		page = TDF.getCustomPage(self.ownerComp.parent.Widget, 'OPs')
		expr = "me.dock.op('" + self.ownerComp.name + "')"
		for p in page.pars:
			if p.eval() == self.ownerComp:
				expr = "me.dock.par." + p.name + ".eval()"
				break
		return expr

	def makePanelExecute(self, panelExpr=None):
		"""
		Creates a panel execute DAT for running external code from the
		widget that is connected to the button interaction receiver - which
		is the ownerComp of this class

		panelExpr: will be used as the expression in the panel parameter of the
			panelExec. Defaults to "me.dock.op('" + self.ownerComp.name +"')"
		"""
		panelExecPar = self.PanelExecPar
		peDat = panelExecPar.eval()
		expr = self.getDockExpressionToOwner() \
											if panelExpr is None else panelExpr
		if not peDat:
			peDat = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.parent().create(
				panelexecuteDAT, self.parPrefix + 'PanelExec')
			peDat.nodeX = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.nodeX - 200
			peDat.nodeY = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget.nodeY
			peDat.dock = self.ownerComp.parent.Widget
			peDat.par.panel.expr = expr
			peDat.par.ontooff = True
			peDat.viewer = True
			panelExecPar.val = peDat.name
			panelExecPar.enable = True
			panelExecPar.readOnly = True
			self.ownerComp.op('panelExecOPExec').cook(force=True)
		else:
			if expr not in peDat.par.panel.expr:
				peDat.par.panel.expr += ', ' + expr
		panelExecPar.eval().par.edit.pulse()

	@property
	def PanelExecPar(self):
		return getattr(parent.Widget.par, self.parPrefix + 'panelexec', None)

# Text Component callbacks

def onValueChange(comp, value, prevValue):
	"""
	Called whenever the text component's value parameter changes for any reason including typing
	in the text window or changing the parameter directly. The callback is equivalent to the
	onValueChange in the parameter exectute DAT.
	
	Args:
		comp: the text component
		value: the new value
		prevValue: the previous value
	"""
	#debug('\nonValueChange comp:', comp.path, '- new value: ', value, ', prev value: ', prevValue )
	return
	
def onFocus(comp):
	"""
	Called when one of the text components viewers gets keyboard focus. 
	
	Args:
		comp: the text component
	"""
	#debug('\nonFocus comp:', comp.path)
	return

def onFocusEnd(comp, info):
	"""
	Called when one of the text component's viewers loses keyboard focus. In regular editing mode
	this is right after the contents are saved back to the value parameter. This function is called
	everytime the viewer loses focus, even if the text does not change.
	
	Args:
		comp: the text component
		info: a dictionary containing information about the event including:
			reason: a string indicating what caused the viewer to lose focus e.g. 'enter', 'escape', 'tab', 'unknown'
	
	"""
	#debug('\nonFocusEnd comp:', comp.path, '- info:\n', info)
	return
	
def onTextEdit(comp):
	"""
	Called each time the contents of the text component viewer change i.e. when typing a character,
	deleting text, cutting or pasting. 
	
	Args:
		comp: the text component
	"""
	#debug('\nonTextEdit comp:', comp.path, '- text: ', comp.editText)
	return
	
def onTextEditEnd(comp, value, prevValue):
	"""
	Called when the user finishes editing and the value has been changed. Not called in 'Continuous Edit' mode. Use
	onTextEdit and onFocusEnd when using continuous editing.
	
	Args:
		comp: the text component
		value: the new value
		prevValue: the previous value
	"""
	#debug('\nonTextEditEnd comp:', comp.path, '- new value: ', value, ', prev value: ', prevValue )
	return

# panelValue - the PanelValue object that changed

def onValueChange(panelValue):
    parent().par.value0 = panelValue
    print('[TD Bridge DEBUG] Launch button state changed:', panelValue)
